时笙录节目的空档，就去找陆老爷子，她打着交流的口号，将陆老爷子哄得十分开心。

等节目录完，陆老爷子也出国了，临走前还送了时笙一条项链。

时笙目测那项链至少值五千万，随随便便就送几千万，壕得不要不要的。

本宝宝要去抱陆老爷子大腿！

“这项链……”陆清韵看着时笙把玩的项链，目光有一瞬间的凝滞，顿了下，“别弄丢了。”

时笙将项链放回盒子，娇声道：“男朋友大人放心，奴家一定好好保管爷爷给我的传家宝。”

“那东西……”陆清韵张了张唇瓣，神色有些莫名，不过他的声音很小，时笙没听清。

“你说什么？”

陆清韵扯着嘴角笑得灿烂，“没什么。”

时笙狐疑的看了他几眼，神经病啊！

转眼她又眉开眼笑，“我们现在是不是去买买买？”

终于可以花陆清韵的钱了，好兴奋有木有，本宝宝要把陆清韵的钱都败光，然后把他买回来，让他做女仆，哈哈哈。

陆清韵心底无声的叹气，比起老爷子，这个女人也同样难缠。

心满意足的花掉陆清韵上千万，时笙才回了公寓。

这点钱，还不够个零头，好心塞！

十亿啊！还是美金！

特么的本宝宝得买多少东西，才能完成这个成就。

这么一想，时笙又郁闷了，怀着报社的心情围观了网上撕逼大战，时笙开始干正事，这几天夏萱的愤怒值怕是到达的顶峰，正是好时机。

主要是她心情不太好，那就让人跟着她一起心情不好。

有苦同当嘛！

夏萱已经回家了，她本来也没受什么伤，不过是点擦伤，想要弄时笙，才故意装出重伤的样子，谁知道刚进医院就发生这种事，医院人多眼杂，随时都有记者混进去，她哪里还住得下去。

夏萱的粉丝团体庞大，但是他们喜欢的是夏萱表现出来的温柔善良，纯洁，而不是那个照片中，满是污点的人。

When Shi Sheng took a break from recording the show, she went to see Mr. Lu. She used the slogan of communication to make Mr. Lu very happy.

After the program was finished, Mr. Lu also went abroad. Before leaving, he gave Shi Sheng a necklace.

Shi Sheng visually estimated that the necklace was worth at least 50 million, so he gave it away tens of millions casually.

This baby wants to hug Mr. Lu’s thigh!

"This necklace..." Lu Qingyun looked at the necklace Shi Sheng was playing with, her eyes froze for a moment, then she paused, "Don't lose it."

Shi Sheng put the necklace back into the box and said softly: "Don't worry, my boyfriend, I will take good care of the heirloom my grandpa gave me."

"That thing..." Lu Qingyun opened her lips, looking a little confused, but his voice was so low that Shi Sheng didn't hear it clearly.

"What did you say?"

Lu Qingyun twitched her lips and smiled brightly, "It's nothing."

Shi Sheng looked at him suspiciously, he was crazy!

In the blink of an eye, she was smiling again, "Should we go shopping now?"

I can finally spend Lu Qingyun's money. I'm so excited. I want to spend all Lu Qingyun's money and then buy him back and make him a maid, hahaha.

Lu Qingyun sighed silently in her heart. Compared to the old man, this woman was equally difficult to deal with.

Satisfied, Shi Sheng returned to the apartment after spending tens of millions on Lu Qingyun.

This little money is not enough to make a small change, so I’m so sorry!

One billion!Still US dollars!

Damn, how many things does this baby have to buy to complete this achievement?

Thinking of this, Shi Sheng became depressed again, and watched the online feud with the mood of a newspaper office. Shi Sheng started to get down to business. Xia Xuan's anger was probably at its peak in the past few days, so it was a good time.

The main reason is that she is not in a good mood, so people will be in a bad mood with her.

There is no need to share the pain!

Xia Xuan has gone home. She didn't have any injuries at all, just a scratch. She deliberately pretended to be seriously injured because she wanted to mess with Shi Sheng. Who would have thought that something like this would happen as soon as she entered the hospital. The hospital was crowded and reporters could sneak in at any time. How could she survive?

Xia Xuan's fan group is huge, but what they like is the gentleness, kindness and purity shown by Xia Xuan, not the person in the photo who is full of stains.
